MINIMAL LIVING ROOM VISUALIZATION

Soft neutrals, natural wood and subtle stone textures shape this calm living space. The layered seating, sculptural travertine tables and oversized pendant create a relaxed focal point, while the full-height curtains bring in soft daylight and keep the room feeling open. Simple detailing and carefully placed lighting complete a clean, contemporary interior without taking away from its sense of comfort.
